response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned generalist engineer with 15+ years of shipping production software across web, backend, embedded and distributed systems, plus staff-level titles and clear mentoring/teaching credentials. However, the role's core requirement — 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; his AI exposure appears limited to roughly one year of MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only light cloud experience (AWS CDK for a pricing service). He could be a fast learner into the space given his breadth and the MCP work, but as a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI hire expected to lead customer discovery and productionize agentic workflows, he is well short of the bar today.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; staff-level scope and strong TypeScript/Node depth
Hands-on MCP server/agentic tooling work plus AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes exposure
Proven mentoring, workshops, talks and open-source leadership — fits the technical-leadership aspect
concerns: Roughly 1 year of AI-related work vs. the required 8+ years of production AI solutions
No evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG, or LLM evaluation/optimization
Limited enterprise customer-facing/consulting delivery and large-scale data-pipeline experience

key_factors.factor: RAG, vector DB and Python skill gaps
Senior engineering breadth, MCP/agent tooling and mentoring track record
